description: Source code for a plugin settings dialog in the XFCE panel, including UI construction, theme selection, and configuration handling.

methods.name: closebutton_builder_new
methods.description: Creates a GtkBuilder from a string buffer, retrieves the dialog object, and sets up weak references for cleanup.

methods.name: closebutton_plugin_combo_addselect
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a GtkComboBoxText and selects it if it matches a given property.

methods.name: closebutton_plugin_find_in_stock
methods.description: Finds a theme or icon in the stock entries array, returning its index.

methods.name: closebutton_plugin_combo_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in the theme selection combo box, updating the plugin property accordingly.

methods.name: closebutton_plugin_configure_plugin
methods.description: Displays the configuration dialog for the plugin, populating theme options and handling user interaction.
